limitations: P/S codes describe open-market OR private transactions, not verified exchange executions or directional signals.
Code/direction contradictions, amendments and footnotes require primary-source review; no rows are repaired or removed. Diagnostics overlap and cannot be summed as distinct transactions.
Form 10b5-1 flag is submission-level and does not establish every individual row was under a valid plan or imply intent.
Transaction and filing fields are date-only; calendar-day differences are not business-day deadlines, compliance findings or first-public timestamps.
Shares, prices and ownership remain as filed. No currency is inferred, no dollar totals or current positions computed, and reporting-owner joins do not multiply transaction rows.
No owner names, addresses or individual transaction values appear in the public aggregate. Private row hashes/rowids bind original data, not source authenticity or prospectively known features.
A row without listed diagnostics is not financially qualified, a complete validation or an approved training example. Derivative transactions/holdings are outside this scoped audit.
